verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a JavaScript UI framework consumed entirely as code. It has no product UI of its own whose actions could be matched by an API, so API-versus-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows a SolidJS-provided UI, such as a hosted dashboard, against which parity could be judged.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
